# ENV001: Conflicting active Python versions

<!-- Code generated by cmd/rulegen from the builtin registry. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Component: python. Severity: error.

Collector prerequisites: runtimes.

Active Python command aliases resolve to different installed versions.

Evidence required: At least two active Python aliases with known, differing metadata versions.

Manual steps:

- Activate the intended environment and align python and python3 on PATH.

- Unknown metadata versions do not establish a conflict. Discovery never executes PATH interpreters.
- Python and python3 resolve independently; a venv invocation remains distinct from its system symlink target.
